newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land to brief media on dividend rise.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land to brief media on dividend rise.

text.p: Tokyo Disneyland operator Oriental Land Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would hold a news conference on a larger dividend and other benefits for its shareholders and the establishment of a subsidiary at 4.15 p.m. (0715 GMT).
The company did not provide any further details.

Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported in its evening edition on Tuesday that Oriental Land planned to provide entrance and ride tickets to Tokyo Disneyland to shareholders with at least 100 shares in the company.
The paper also said the company may pay an annual dividend larger than its previous forecast.
The company has said it will pay a 10 yen annual dividend for the year to March 31, up two yen from the year before. It may increase that to 11 to 12 yen, the paper said.
